text: つよく　なるには　むし　ポケモンの　ほかも　さがさないと　ダメ　だな

structure.jp: むし　ポケモンの　ほかも
structure.en: things other than Bug Pokémon too

structure.jp: さがさないと　ダメ　だな
structure.en: I have to look for, I guess

patterns.name: 〜ないとだめだ
patterns.span: さがさないと　ダメ　だ
patterns.explanation: ないと　だめだ is 'if I don't ..., it's no good', which is how Japanese says 'I have to'. さがさないと　ダメ　だ = 'I have to look for them'.

patterns.name: 〜には (purpose)
patterns.explanation: には after a plain verb means 'in order to do that'. つよく　なるには = 'in order to get stronger'.

patterns.name: 〜くなる
patterns.explanation: An い-word changed to く plus なる means 'to become' that way. つよく　なる = 'to become strong'.
